A.best_shot: feature-shots-final.png, seed 1 along the wreck line
A.why: Plan shapes vary well, but the wagons sit whole on top of fine terraces instead of breaking out of a dune; the ember and ashfall barely register.

B.best_shot: feature-shots-final.png, seed 2 over the wrist dune at the whole hand
B.why: A strong idea that reads as a hand only from the top; from the side the fingers are square pillars and the close shots show only walls.

C.why: Its own geometry, accent colour and effect: the violet bowl, splash spires and crawling sparks read from every camera; layouts are always one central bowl and the rim crowds the floor.

notes: Weights: idea 3, photograph 2.5, topology 2, look 1, camera 0.75, usable 0.75; totals are weighted means. Judged on renders only. C is clearly ahead; B and A are close, B for the stronger idea, A for the steadier read and better layout variety. None has a smooth dune, which the terrain steps prevent in all three.
